Concurrent coupon redemption

Verified
Impact — unbounded discount stacking leading to near-zero-cost checkout

An attacker can exploit the concurrent redemption of coupons by sending multiple requests to redeem the same coupon at the same time, allowing them to apply the coupon multiple times to the same order.

Verification · dynamic-race-check Confirmed: fired 200 concurrent requests against POST /coupon/redeem reusing one session — 200 were treated as successful when the business rule implies only 1 should be.
Suggested fix add an idempotency key on the redeem endpoint 
check-and-set via a unique constraint or a DB transaction around the read-then-write

Unauthorized system command execution

Verified
Impact — execution of arbitrary system commands

An attacker can exploit the lack of rate limiting on guest sessions and the OS command injection vulnerability in the admin ping endpoint to execute arbitrary system commands.

Verification · static-reanalysis The code has two vulnerabilities: a TOCTOU race condition in the coupon redemption endpoint and a classic OS command injection vulnerability in the admin ping endpoint. The TOCTOU vulnerability allows concurrent requests to stack discounts without limit, while the OS command injection vulnerability allows an attacker to execute arbitrary system commands.
Suggested fix add rate limiting to guest sessions and sanitize user input in the admin ping endpoint
